name: Bootstrap
phase_role: Temporary/basic starter production while unlocking stable logistics.
expansion_intent: Reserve straight 120/min corridors; temporary machines may be replaced.
transition_trigger: Reach Mk.2 belts / stable starter resource feed.

name: Starter Works Baseline
phase_role: Permanent early construction-material and Project Assembly starter production.
expansion_intent: Keep module edges open for reserve Iron activation and storage expansion.
transition_trigger: Mk.2 miners and/or need for higher starter surplus.

name: Expanded Starter / Storage
phase_role: Increase starter surplus, activate reserves as needed, integrate dimensional storage/overflow.
expansion_intent: Expand outward; avoid inserting new machines into core chains.
transition_trigger: Construction demand or downstream consumption justifies reserve activation.

name: Home / Logistics Interchange
phase_role: Transition from primary production center toward mall/storage/interchange.
expansion_intent: Prioritize storage/logistics frontage over dense new local production.
transition_trigger: Regional transport network becomes primary.

name: Coal Power Commission
phase_role: First autonomous coal-power grid using local coal and water.
expansion_intent: Reserve generator and water-extractor expansion line.
transition_trigger: Power demand exceeds initial block.

name: Coal Power Expansion
phase_role: Expand autonomous generation using additional local coal capacity.
expansion_intent: Add generator blocks rather than rework existing manifold.
transition_trigger: Mk.2 mining and/or sustained regional power demand.

name: Shared Coal Release
phase_role: Potentially release conditional coal capacity after stronger power sources are established.
expansion_intent: No default physical recommendation beyond preserving optional export access.
transition_trigger: Power district no longer requires all reserved coal.

name: Steel Commissioning
phase_role: Bring basic Steel Beam and Steel Pipe production online for progression and construction.
expansion_intent: Build permanent manifolds with unused extension length reserved for later machines rather than duplicating lines.
transition_trigger: Need Encased Industrial Beam production before Encased Industrial Pipe is available.

name: Initial Encased Beam Production
phase_role: Produce Encased Industrial Beams with the default Steel Beam + Concrete recipe while continuing Steel Pipe production for construction and later use.
expansion_intent: Extend the existing Beam and Pipe lines in place; reserve a Pipe-side EIB branch for the later recipe transition.
transition_trigger: Encased Industrial Pipe alternate recipe acquired.

name: Encased Industrial Pipe Transition
phase_role: Move Encased Industrial Beam production from Steel Beam + Concrete to Steel Pipe + Concrete; Pipe becomes the dominant shared steel intermediate.
expansion_intent: Retain Beam production for construction/project demand while extending the Pipe manifold to EIB and other consumers.
transition_trigger: Steel Rotor and broader motor-component production justified.

name: Permanent 270/min Steel / Motor Components
phase_role: Operate mature pipe-heavy steel production with dedicated EIB, Rotor, Stator, and downstream Motor capacity.
expansion_intent: Extend existing manifolds first; duplicate a line only after belt capacity, footprint length, or logistics makes further extension undesirable.
transition_trigger: Regional rail backbone and/or higher export demand.

name: Rail-Integrated Steel Expansion
phase_role: Connect mature steel outputs to regional logistics and expand throughput as needed.
expansion_intent: Continue same-line extension where practical; add parallel/duplicate lines only when a physical or throughput limit is reached.
transition_trigger: Late-game regional demand or logistics constraints.

name: Temporary Oil
phase_role: Early plastic/rubber with residue safety valve; do not overbuild.
expansion_intent: Keep crude capacity and physical space uncommitted for permanent fuel/recycling architecture.
transition_trigger: Preferred oil alternates available.

name: Permanent Petrochemical
phase_role: Heavy Oil Residue + recycled plastic/rubber architecture.
expansion_intent: Separate plastic/rubber modules with independent storage and room for fuel expansion.
transition_trigger: Fuel/power or downstream petrochemical demand.

name: Fuel / Power Expansion
phase_role: Mature fuel production and regional power expansion.
expansion_intent: Extend fuel and generator modules along reserved fluid/logistics corridors.
transition_trigger: Diluted Fuel and sustained power demand.

name: Structural Reserve
phase_role: Reserve footprint/resources for later HMF production.
expansion_intent: Preserve resource access and factory pad; defer detailed topology.
transition_trigger: Industrial Manufacturing and preferred HMF recipe.

name: Heavy Modular Frame Works
phase_role: Permanent Modular Frame → Heavy Modular Frame chain.
expansion_intent: Leave logistics/import side open for steel/concrete feeds and later Fused Frames.
transition_trigger: Heavy Encased Frame secured.

name: Fused Frame Expansion
phase_role: Add Fused Modular Frame production when late inputs/logistics justify it.
expansion_intent: Expand outward from HMF output/logistics edge.
transition_trigger: Late-game fused-frame demand.

name: Bauxite Claim / Logistics
phase_role: Secure Bauxite extraction and move ore toward reliable water.
expansion_intent: Preserve downhill/rail logistics corridor; avoid heavy highland processing.
transition_trigger: Preferred aluminum recipes available.

name: Permanent Aluminum
phase_role: Water-side alumina/scrap/ingot production using simplified aluminum chain.
expansion_intent: Separate wet process, scrap, ingot, and export edges; preserve room for more bauxite feed.
transition_trigger: Sloppy Alumina + Pure Aluminum Ingot.

name: Aluminum Expansion / Export
phase_role: Increase aluminum throughput and rail export.
expansion_intent: Add repeated process blocks near water/logistics edge.
transition_trigger: Late-game aluminum demand.

name: Site Selection / Junction
phase_role: Select buildable, rail-accessible logistics/advanced-manufacturing location.
expansion_intent: Reserve broad station/campus footprint and multiple approach directions.
transition_trigger: Regional rail backbone planning.

name: Advanced Manufacturing
phase_role: Consolidate low-volume T7-T9 advanced assembly.
expansion_intent: Organize around logistics frontage; add independent advanced modules.
transition_trigger: Imported advanced part flows established.

name: Late Logistics Hub
phase_role: Regional rail/drone interchange and late-game export/import consolidation.
expansion_intent: Reserve station/drone expansion zones and avoid blocking trunk corridors.
transition_trigger: Late-game logistics demand.
